snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Owlcat Games reveal a new game in Warhammer 40,000 Universe. Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Find more about Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy at https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/

Join the Inquisition:
Wishlist Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710600/Warhammer_40000_Dark_Heresy/
Pre-order Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy on our website:
https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/
